book.name: San Lucas
book.title: DIŽAꞋ GÜEN DANꞋ BZOJ SAN LUCAS

content: Juan gwdix̱jue'ede' diža' güen c̱he Diosa'

Cate' ḻo iz šino' dan' chnabia' César Tiberio doxen ga mbane nación Roma, izna' goc Poncio Pilato gobernador c̱he distritw Judea, na' goc Herodes gobernador c̱he distritw Galilea. Na' beṉe' biše' Herodesen', ben' le Felipe, goque' gobernador c̱he distritw Itorea na' c̱he distritw Traconite. Na' goc Lisanias gobernador c̱he distritw Abilinia.
Nach ḻecze izna' Anás na' Caifás gosacche' bx̱oz blao c̱he beṉe' Israel. Izna' Juan ben' naque' xi'iṉ Zacarías gwzoe' to latje daš. Nach Diosen' be'lene' Juanṉa' diža'.
Na' Juanṉa' gwyeje' yogo'ḻoḻ yež dan' nita' gaḻa'ze yegw Jordán, jatix̱jue'ede' yogo'ḻoḻ beṉe' cheyaḻa' yesyetiṉjde' xtoḻa'gaque' na' yesezoe' nis cont ṉitlao xtoḻa'gaquen'.
Juanṉa' bene' dan' bzoj da' Isaías ben' be' xtiža' Diosen' cani'te, gana' žan:

content.text: Bena' chṉe' zižje latje dašen', že':
“Ḻe gonšagüe' yic̱hjlažda'olen' cont soale gwzenagle c̱he X̱anchon' cate' yide',
ḻe cuejyic̱hj da' malen' chonḻe cont yic̱hjlažda'olen' gaquen ca to nez da' ba gosonšagüe'.
Gwžin ža cate' yogo' ya'a yegw ca' yesyeyaquen laše',
na' no nez da' nacchgua bxoca' yesyeyaquen ḻicha,
na' no nez da' nžaš nche'eṉe yesyeyaquen ba'a.
Na' yogo'ḻoḻ beṉe' yesacbe'ede' can' chaclaže' Diosen' yebeje' beṉac̱hen' ḻo da' mal.”

content: Na' beṉe' zan ja'aque' gan' gwzoa Juanṉa' cont gwzoe'ne' nis. Na' Juanṉa' gože' ḻegaque': ―Le'e nacchguale beṉe' zgot na' beṉe' gwxiye'. ¿Chaquele guac yelale lao castigw dan' seḻa' Diosen' caten' gone' yeḻa' justis c̱he beṉac̱hen'?

Še da' ḻi ba betiṉjele xtoḻa'le, cheyaḻa' gonḻe da' nac güen cont yesacbe'e beṉe' ba boša' yic̱hjlažda'olen'. Na' bitw gonḻe xbab gaquele Diosen' bitw gone' le'e castigw c̱he xtoḻa'len' lagüe da' nacle xi'iṉ diaža c̱he da' Abrahanṉa'. Bitw ṉacho ḻeca chyažje Diosen' le'e. Guac gone' cont yej quinga yesyeyaquen xi'iṉ diaža c̱he da' Abrahanṉa'.
Ca nac le'e, še bi chonḻe can' chazlaže' Diosen', zaca'leble ca to yag frut da' bibi chbia. Na' yogo'te yag frut da' bibi chbia, c̱hog x̱an yaga' ḻen na' gwzeyen'.
Nach beṉe' ca' chosozenag xtiže'na' goseṉabde' Juanṉa', gose'ene': ―¿Bica' da' cheyaḻa' gonto'?
Na' gože' ḻegaque': ―Ben' nape' c̱hope camis cheyaḻa' gwnežjue' ton c̱he beṉe' bi de c̱he'. Na' ḻecze ca' c̱he ben' de da' gagüe', cheyaḻa' gwnežjue' c̱he ben' bi de gagüe'.
Na' cate' to c̱hope beṉe' güec̱hixjw ca' jasebigue' cont gwzoa Juanṉa' ḻegaque' nis, na' gose'ene': ―Maestrw, ¿bica' da' cheyaḻa' gonto'?
Na' gože' ḻegaque': ―Bitw gwc̱hixjwchle ca da' cheyaḻa' yeseyixjue'.

Na' to c̱hope beṉe' ca' zjanac soldadw ḻecze goseṉabde' ḻe', gose'ene': ―¿C̱hix neto'? ¿Bica'ch da' cheyaḻa' gonto'? Na' Juanṉa' gože' ḻegaque': ―Bitw ca'ale da' de c̱he beṉe', na' ṉeca gonḻaže'le len da' yosbague'le beṉe' cont ca'ale xmechwgaque'. Ḻe gon banez len laxjwle.
Na' beṉe' ca' gosezoe' lez yid Cristo ben' naquen seḻa' Diosen' yedeṉabi'e, na' gosacde' še Juanṉa' naque' Cristo.

Na' Juanṉa' gocbe'ede' xbab c̱hegaquen' na' gože' yogo'ḻoḻe': ―Neda' da' ḻi chzoa' le'e nis, perw za' yid bena' gon cont soa Spiritw c̱he Diosen' ḻo' yic̱hjlažda'olen' ṉabian' le'e. Na' Spiriton' naquen ca yi', na' gwxi gwloan yic̱hjlažda'ole. Bena' za' za' zaca'che' ca neda', na' da' nacchgüe' beṉe zaca' bitw zaca' gona' xmandadoe' ḻec̱hja' no xele'.

Benan' gone' len beṉac̱hen' can' choncho cate' chdecho trigon' ḻo' rner. Chtobcho trigon' chgo'ošagüe'chon na' chzeycho yix beben'. Na' beṉe' chesejnilaže' Diosen', yotobe' ḻegaque' cont šjasyenite' txen len ḻe', na' beṉe' bi chesejnilaže' ḻe', seḻe' ḻegaque' ḻo yi' gabiḻen' dan' cbi cheyol chenit.
Da' zanch da' gwna Juanṉa' gwdix̱jue'ede' ḻegaque' diža' güen, na' gwṉeyoede' ḻegaque' yesejḻe'en.

Nach Juanṉa' gwdiḻe' gobernador Herodes ca nac da' mal da' bene' beque'e Herodías ca xo'ole', ḻe Herodíasna' naque' xo'ole Felipe beṉe' biše' Herodesen'. Na' Juanṉa' ḻecze be'e diža' yogo'ḻoḻ da' mal dan' ba ben Herodes.
Na' Herodesen', gualaz da' gwzenague' c̱he Juanṉa', benche' yeto da' mal, gwlo'e Juanṉa' ḻižya.
Can' goc caten' gwzoa Jesúsen' nis
Nach šlac chzoa Juanṉa' beṉe' nis, beṉe' zan ja'ac cont bzoe' ḻegaque' nis. Na' len Jesúsen' gwzoe' nis. Na' ḻo hora' Jesúsen' boḻ güiže' Diosen' na' ḻa' byaljwte yaba gan' zoa Diosen'.

Na' betj Spiritw c̱he Diosen' bžinen gwzoan len ḻe', na' ca hora' Spiriton' naquen ca to ngolbex. Na' gosende' gwṉe Dios ben' zoa yaban', gwne': ―Le' naco' Xi'iṉa' beṉe' chacchgüeda', na' chebe chezaquelaže'chgüeda' c̱hio'.
Diaža c̱he Jesúsen'
Na' ca do šichoa ize Jesúsen' cate' gwzolao bene' yogo'ḻoḻ da' zedeyene'. Na' beṉe' ca' gwnita' na' gosone' xbab še naque' xi'iṉ Joséna'. Josén' naque' xi'iṉ Elí,
na' Elí naque' xi'iṉ Matat, na' Matata' naque' xi'iṉ Leví, na' Levína' naque' xi'iṉ Melqui, na' Melquin' naque' xi'iṉ Jana, na' Janan' naque' xi'iṉ yeto ben' le' José.
Na' Joséna' naque' xi'iṉ Matatías, na' Matatíasen' naque' xi'iṉ Amós, na' Amósen' naque' xi'iṉ Nahum, na' Nahunṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Esli. Na' Eslin' naque' xi'iṉ Nagai,
na' Nagain' naque' xi'iṉ Maat, na' Maata' naque' xi'iṉ Matatías, na' Matatíasen' naque' xi'iṉ Semei, na' Semein' naque' xi'iṉ José, na' Josén' naque' xi'iṉ Judá.
Na' Judán' naque' xi'iṉ Joana, na' Joanan' naque' xi'iṉ Resa, na' Resan' naque' xi'iṉ Zorobabel, na' Zorobabelen' naque' xi'iṉ Salatiel, na' Salatielen' naque' xi'iṉ Neri,
na' Nerin' naque' xi'iṉ Melqui, na' Melquin' naque' xi'iṉ Adi, na' Adin' naque' xi'iṉ Cosam, na' Cosanṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Elmodam, na' Elmodanṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Er.
Na' Era' naque' xi'iṉ Josué, na' Josuén' naque' xi'iṉ Eliezer, na' Eliezeren' naque' xi'iṉ Jorim, na' Jorinṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Matat.
Na' Mataten' naque' xi'iṉ Leví, na' Levín' naque' xi'iṉ Simeón, na' Simeóna' naque' xi'iṉ Judá, na' Judán' naque' xi'iṉ José, na' Josén' naque' xi'iṉ Jonán, na' Jonánṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Eliaquim.
Na' Eliaquinṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Melea, na' Melean' naque' xi'iṉ Mainán, na' Mainánṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Matata, na' Matatan' naque' xi'iṉ Natán.
Na' Natánṉa' naque' xi'iṉ David, na' Davida' naque' xi'iṉ Isaí, na' Isaín' naque' xi'iṉ Obed, na' Obeda' naque' xi'iṉ Booz, na' Boozen' naque' xi'iṉ Salmón, na' Salmónṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Naasón.
Na' Naasónṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Aminadab, na' Aminadaba' naque' xi'iṉ Aram, na' Aranṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Esrom, na' Esronṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Fares. Na' Faresen' naque' xi'iṉ Judá,
na' Judán' naque' xi'iṉ Jacob, na' Jacoben' naque' xi'iṉ Isaac, na' Isaaquen' naque' xi'iṉ Abraham, na' Abrahanṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Taré, na' Tarén' naque' xi'iṉ Nacor.
Na' Nacoren' naque' xi'iṉ Serug, na' Seruga' naque' xi'iṉ Ragau, na' Ragaun' naque' xi'iṉ Peleg, na' Peleguen' naque' xi'iṉ Heber. Na' Heberen' naque' xi'iṉ Sala,
na' Salan' naque' xi'iṉ Cainán, na' Cainánṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Arfaxad, na' Arfaxaden' naque' xi'iṉ Sem, na' Senṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Noé, na' Noén' naque' xi'iṉ Lamec.
Na' Lamequen' naque' xi'iṉ Matusalén, na' Matusalénṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Enoc, na' Enoca' naque' xi'iṉ Jared, na' Jareden' naque' xi'iṉ Mahalaleel. Na' Mahalaleela' naque' xi'iṉ Cainán,
na' Cainánṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Enós, na' Enósen' naque' xi'iṉ Set, na' Seta' naque' xi'iṉ Adán, na' Adánṉa' naque' xi'iṉ Dios.
